text:
nora.marketing: quick thread ":wave:" — proposing a staggered enrichment + debounce loop for inbound during big campaign spikes. goal: reduce cold claims without creating a priority lane.

ben-sdr: curious how "staggered" differs from previous prefetch ideas? we had fields showing up mid-claim before.

nora.marketing: this one adds three pieces: 1) stagger windows (clients get prefetch attempts randomized 0-5s), 2) short debounce so RR won't re-evaluate assignment while prefetch pending, and 3) explicit temp props so reps know it's provisional.

claire-salesops: sounds promising. need to be explicit: debounce must not hold leads long enough to skew RR. what's the max debounce?

nora.marketing: default debounce 3s, max 6s for high-intent. claim logic will prefer prefetched leads only for a 25s prefer window. no assignment weight changes.

hs-sync-bot: HS mapping required: add props `stagger_prefetch_state` (pending|prefetched|failed), `stagger_prefetch_ts`, and `stagger_temp_company`. SF mapping will carry `stagger_prefetch_state`.

james-ops: sample flag and config I can flip quickly: ```json
{"flag":"routing.staggered_prefetch.v1","canary_pct":2,"stagger_max_ms":5000,"prefetch_timeout_ms":2500,"debounce_ms":3000,"prefer_window_ms":25000}
```

ivy-growth: cohort = campaign:launch_q4 + leadscore>65. start 2% then 8% if stable. we should also monitor whether SDRs get confused by temp props.

ben-sdr: yes please add a small HUD note in HS and a one-liner in rep messages. last time people thought temp_company was real.

claire-salesops: runbook idea: if enrichment arrives after claim, rep leaves quick "enrich_added" comment and flags if data conflicts. automated follow-up task at 2h if temp props still present.

james-ops: metrics I'll push to the handoff dashboard: `staggered_prefetch_attempts`, `prefetch_success_before_claim_pct`, `claims_with_temp_props_pct`, `rr_rebalance_index`, `claim_latency_p95_ms`, and `manual_promote_rate`. auto-rollback thresholds: rr_rebalance_index > 10% or claim_latency_p95 increases by >15%.

hs-sync-bot: sample webhook (staging): ```json
{ "lead_id": "L-9999", "stagger_prefetch_state": "prefetched", "stagger_prefetch_ts": 4132103387, "stagger_temp_company": "Orbit Co (temp)", "prefetch_score": 0.87 }
```

ivy-growth: communication plan: short Slack in #sales + one-pager with examples and exact HS prop names. we'll include gif showing temp fields flagged.

ben-sdr: thanks — please make the one-pager. i can take rep feedback during the canary.

nora.marketing: ops to push staging smoke today. prod canary 2% at 6pm PT. monitor cadence: +5m, +30m, +2h. check-in Fri 10am PT to widen/rollback. :rocket:
